narrative: FY2026 GP is forecast NOK 30M below budget. Volume and mix explain −NOK 32M (conversational −12, campaign SMS −9, verification −8, platform −3), price adds +NOK 6M and termination costs −NOK 4M. Wholesale is on budget.

signals.title: FY2026 GP forecast NOK 30M short of the double-digit ambition
signals.source: SDP Q3 Forecast (9+3) vs FY2026 Budget (MyLINK CORE ambition)
signals.excerpt: Gross profit lands at NOK 1,690M (+8.2% on FY2025), NOK 30M (1.7%) below the NOK 1,720M ambition. Growth is broad across the five European markets; the gap is a mix issue, not a market issue.

signals.title: Nordic operators raise A2P termination 5–7% from 1 January
signals.source: Operator notices (Telenor, Telia, Telia Finland) — Carrier & Termination Cost phase
signals.excerpt: Termination cost is NOK 5,773M, 77% of revenue. Routing absorbs part of the increase; the remainder must be passed through in Enterprise SMS pricing to protect GP per message.
